* * *

## [I ordered x2 rugs for a project I am…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a43c618a4f7a4ee2512a482)

I ordered x2 rugs for a project I am working on, and the items did not arrive on time, despite what the site said just before clicking Purchase....

It has been nearly impossible to get an answer with customer service. I've left messages and no response. It's been over 48 hours since I initiated the return and still no news.....The customer support has been abysmal.....

June 16, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 30, 2026

Hi Lisa,

Thank you for your feedback. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience regarding the additional transit time for your oversized rug, which required shipping with our freight carrier. The lead time given at the time of purchase was accurate. I can confirm that our Customer support team has assisted with your cancellation, and your refund will be processed shortly along with a confirmation receipt emailed to you for your records.

Lulu and Georgia
